messages.subject: Stan Case Studies launched (+ plea for lost knitr doc!)
parts:
I starte the Stan Case Studies page with three of my own:

http://mc-stan.org/documentation/case-studies.html

They're for extended knitr/Jupyter docs with Stan code
illustrating some model or methodology or data set (or all
three).

We're taking contributions, as noted at the top of the page.

I know someone had contributed one, but I can't find the
.Rmd file in my mail. So please please send again (with an
open-source license attached plus an abstract and keywords)
and I'll post ASAP. Sorry for misplacing it!

We have eight tutorials for different education models in
the queue, so those should be out soon.

- Bob
